answer: Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the atlas of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
